defects.quote: NO_POLICY for every window means no resource SLA rule existed
defects.why: The window verdict does not establish whether a resource SLA rule existed elsewhere in the configuration.

defects.quote: The metric summaries represent a single transaction (checkout)
defects.why: One summary has overall scope and the other has checkout transaction scope; matching aggregates do not establish single-transaction coverage.

notes: The load-extension and clock checks are useful, but the response overstates what NO_POLICY and matching summaries establish.
